create_stable_diffusion_pipeline: create a StableDiffusionPipeline instance with vae, text_encoder, tokenizer, unet, scheduler, and safety_checker components
run_text_to_image_generation: run text-to-image generation using the StableDiffusionPipeline with prompts, inference steps, and guidance scale
set_k_diffusion_sampler: set a k_diffusion sampler type such as Euler or Heun on the StableDiffusionPipeline for alternative denoising
encode_text_prompts: encode text prompts into hidden state embeddings with optional negative prompts and classifier-free guidance
decode_latents_to_images: decode latent tensors through the VAE into normalized PIL-compatible image arrays
